    from queue import PriorityQueue
    frontier = PriorityQueue()
    frontier.put((0, start))
    came_from = {}
    cost_so_far = {}
    came_from[start] = None
    cost_so_far[start] = 0
    
    while not frontier.empty():

            path.append(goal)
            goal = came_from[goal]
        path.append(start)  # Add start node at the end of the path
        path.reverse()
        return path
